description: Na₆MgV₂O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.34 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.43 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.45 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.44 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.35 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids and corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.92 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ square pyramid, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.86 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra and corners with eight ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃V tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃V tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra and corners with ten ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃V tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃V tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids.
